description.zh:
实例ID。
- 企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
- 公共实例：无需传入此参数。
description.en:
The instance ID.
- Enterprise instance: You must specify this parameter. You can view your Enterprise instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
- Public instance: You do not need to specify this parameter.

description.zh: 需要关联到项目的产品ProductKey列表。
description.en: A list of ProductKeys of the products to be associated with the project.

description.zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看。
description.en:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Application Development Console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). In the upper-left corner of the page, select the target instance. In the left-side navigation pane, click Project Management.
2. In the standard project list, find the target project, click its project card, and then view the project ID in the address bar.

title.zh: 批量绑定产品到项目中
title.en: Batch Attach Products to a Project

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明
- 如果在企业版实例中调用该接口，请求参数**IotInstanceId**必须填写。否则，调用接口会失败。
- 单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
- 单次调用该接口最多可关联10个产品。
descriptions.en:
## Limits
- If you invoke this API in an Enterprise instance, you must specify the **IotInstanceId** request parameter. Otherwise, the API invocation fails.
- Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 queries per second (QPS) to invoke this API.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
- You can associate a maximum of 10 products with a project in a single API call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot batch-bind-products-into-project --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --project-id a12300000000 --product-keys example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
